corrections.proposed: 1933 built (first cabin, lost to lightning that year); 1934 rebuilt as a ground-mounted L-4 cab
corrections.why: The NHLR description and firelookout.com say the first cabin dated from 1933 and was destroyed that year; 1934 is the rebuild date, not the first build.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The South Idaho chapter 2014 annual report describes stabilization work on Morehead in 2014. NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts date a refurbishment to 2015. Both are kept as separate events. The 2014 report does not say whether its stabilization work and the 2015 refurbishment are the same job, and the story says so.
NHLR gives 8,516 ft (2,596 m). Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 8506 ft. The record keeps the NHLR value (2595.7 m).
The NHLR Built field says 1934, but the NHLR description and firelookout.com say the first cabin dated from 1933 and was lost that year. The 1934 date is the L-4 rebuild.

notes_for_editor: Fate (burned in the Boundary Fire, 9 Sept 2021) is corroborated by three sources. No staffing names found: Idaho Fire Lookouts says none documented. Remains today and current access rules are not described by any source read; the story says so. Access level is not set for that reason. The WebSearch budget was used up before this lookout; one earlier websearch.py query surfaced an FFLA Facebook post and a KIFI article on the fire, but neither was read, so neither is cited. The record's 2014 'restored' event is kept as the FFLA report's year, with the NHLR 2015 date alongside.
